milestones.outcome: Names can be added and listed through a persistent, documented CLI.
exit_criteria: The actual subprocess add/list path preserves names across invocations.
Duplicate additions fail without changing the store.
Focused tests and runnable documentation cover that behavior.
milestones.boundary: Persistence, creation, reading, tests and documentation form one usable public path before mutation operations are added.
